mentions.name: Main Duck
mentions.description: A hosted tool that simplifies converting code into MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, with plans for easy CI integration so MCPs can be updated easily.
mentions.problem: Converting existing code into MCP servers is currently difficult and keeping them updated is manual.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on https://main-duck.com/ which simplifies converting your code to mcp. I plan to make this easy to integrate into CI so mcps can be updated easily. It’s hosted remotely and I’m very excited about where it’ll go.
